Delhi launches Electric Vehicles Policy 2026 with subsidies and tax exemptions

Delhi has officially launched its Electric Vehicles Policy 2026, which will take effect on July 1, 2026, and aims to increase the adoption of electric vehicles until March 2030. The policy includes financial incentives such as tax exemptions for electric cars and subsidies for two and three-wheelers. An online portal for purchase and scrapping incentives is expected to launch soon, with plans for direct bank transfers.
